{{Quote|A squadron of TIE fighters? Great! ''Anything's'' better than facing my father &hellip;|Mazer Rackus|<ref name="GG9" />}}
The [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Mazer Rackus]] originally joined the Rebellion at age sixteen after stealing his first [[Starship/Legends|starship]] from his '''father''' and crashing it on a Rebel-controlled [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Rackus served the Alliance for many [[Standard year/Legends|years]], all the while harboring a negative remembrance of his father.
